Is it real?

Yes. When you think in words, the muscles of your throat and jaw move very slightly, as if you were about to speak. Most of this happens below awareness: the unconscious speaks before you do. VOIZEX sensors at the neck read these signals, and a model on the device turns them into words.

  1. You think in words.Even silently, inner speech reaches the muscles.
  2. The muscles move.Too faint to see, strong enough to measure.
  3. The necklace reads them.EMG sensors pick up the signal at the neck.
  4. The case decodes them.AI on the device turns signal into text. Nothing goes to the cloud.

The science.

1968

Sokolov, Institute of Psychology, Moscow

Aleksandr Sokolov placed electrodes on the throat and lips of people reading silently and solving sums in their heads. The speech muscles fired with every word they thought, though no sound was made. Inner speech is physical.

2004

Jorgensen, NASA Ames

Chuck Jorgensen’s team at NASA Ames put small sensors under the chin and on the throat. Words spoken without sound were read from nerve and muscle signals and recognised with 92% accuracy. Signals at the neck carry words.

2026

ETH Zürich, SilentWear

Researchers at ETH Zürich built SilentWear, a wearable EMG system that decodes silent speech with all processing on the device. This is the same direction as VOIZEX: worn every day, private, no cloud.
